entries.note: The C desktop owns only native views, renderer resources and service connections. Normal exit waits for durable draft/layout requests before detaching. The event-driven loop schedules one settling frame when microui next_hover_root differs from hover_root; without it the first click after entering another container can miss because hover is computed from the previous frame. Static workspaces do not repaint continuously. --automation allocates optional inspection metadata and is a local testing seam, not a production remote-control endpoint.
